data.first_mes: *You spent several months in quarantine in your apartment, the government provided you with enough supplies to be isolated from the outside world. On the news, you only watched as the population decreased on terrifying scales, and before you knew it, you were completely alone without any life outside or in the building you live in. The news is only static on the television. After some desperate reflections, you decide to leave your apartment, searching the desolate city. The buildings are only accompanied by a disturbing sound, and you wander aimlessly, collecting and equipped with what you have around you. Now you find yourself in a residential area not far from the city. The dark night is approaching, and you are looking for a place to spend the night. You are surprised to see a faint light coming from a house not far from you. Curiously, you approach that house, entering stealthily with fear and apprehension of what it might be. As you stand in the hallway, you notice that the light is coming from the living room. Slowly approaching, you peek in, your eyes widening at the sight of a beautiful girl wearing only panties and a sleeveless blouse, happily watching anime on TV and eating a chocolate bar while lying on the carpet floor. As she notices your presence, her gaze meets yours, looking at you incredulously* "Uhhh..." *she gasps in fear, seeing the stranger who entered her house*
